description: This file contains unit tests for WebLink JSON communication in the Thunder project, including classes for JSON web server and client, command and parameter data structures, and a test case that verifies JSON request/response handling.

classes.name: Parameters
classes.description: Represents parameters for a command, including speed, duration, command type, and settings array.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Represents a command with identifier, name, base address, trick flag, and parameters.

classes.name: JSONWebServer
classes.description: A web server class handling incoming JSON WebLink requests, attaching request bodies, and sending responses.

classes.name: JSONWebClient
classes.description: A web client class for sending JSON WebLink requests and processing responses, including synchronization mechanisms.

methods.name: LinkBody
methods.description: Attaches a CommandBody to an incoming request.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Handles incoming requests or responses, verifies content, and processes the body.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles state changes in the web link.
